# genderforce

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The genderforce R package provides curated International Labour Organization (ILOSTAT) data and interactive visual tools to explore global labour force participation rates by gender, age, and marital status.

**Documentation & Website**: <https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-nwat0027/>

## Installation

You can install the development version of genderforce from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

```{r}
#| eval: false
# install.packages("remotes") 
remotes::install_github("ETC5523-2026/etc5523-assignment-4-nwat0027")
```
## Dataset Overview 
The package includes the `labor_force_marital` dataset, containing annual labour force participation rates (%) across various countries from 1980 onwards:
```{r example-data} 
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(genderforce) 
library(dplyr)

# View dataset structure 
glimpse(labor_force_marital) 
```

## Example: Calculating the Gender Participation Gap
The package exports `calc_labor_gap()` to summarize male versus female participation rates and calculate the gender gap (percentage points) across marital status categories:

```{r example-calc} 
# Calculate gender gap for Australia in prime working age (25-54) 

calc_labor_gap(target_country = "Australia", target_age = "25-54") 
```

## Interactive Explorer (Shiny App)
`genderforce` comes with a built-in interactive Shiny application that features dynamic country/age dropdowns, year range sliders, trend visualisations, and an executive summary card.

To launch the app: 
```{r}
#| eval: false
run_app() 
```
